notes.36: Overall, there was a slight preference for the correct answer, but some candidates appeared to be guessing. Candidates should be reminded that alkenes react in addition reactions - this would have allowed them to eliminate half the options in this question.
notes.39: Option C was most commonly chosen by candidates who performed less well overall. Candidates should be remined that in organic compounds, carbon forms four bonds, hydrogen one and oxygen two. Hydrogen would therefore not form a double bond and option C could be eliminated.
